leadership.name: Sachin

cocLeadership.title: Owners
cocLeadership.description: Responsible for the overall direction and leadership of FBMR. Has the final say on all major decisions, changes, and community matters.

cocLeadership.title: Game Overseer
cocLeadership.description: Oversees the game, development, updates, gameplay systems, and the overall game experience.

cocLeadership.title: Chairman
cocLeadership.description: Leads the ownership structure and oversees major organizational decisions, departments, leadership, and the overall direction of FBMR.

cocLeadership.title: Vice Chairman
cocLeadership.description: Assists the Chairman with organizational leadership, oversees assigned responsibilities, handles major situations, and steps in when needed.

cocLeadership.title: Chief Operations Officer
cocLeadership.description: Oversees day-to-day operations and ensures departments and leadership are functioning properly.

cocLeadership.title: Chief Logistic Officer
cocLeadership.description: Oversees policies, regulations, finance matters, and organizational compliance.

cocLeadership.title: Chief Relations Officer
cocLeadership.description: Handles external relations, partnerships, communications, and FBMR’s public image.

cocLeadership.title: Head of Development
cocLeadership.description: Leads the development team, oversees development projects, assigns responsibilities, manages updates, and ensures the game experience is maintained.

cocLeadership.title: General Manager
cocLeadership.description: Oversees the overall management of FBMR and ensures leadership teams are meeting organizational standards.

cocLeadership.title: Director of National Intelligence
cocLeadership.description: Oversees intelligence, investigations, internal information, and organizational security.

cocLeadership.title: Staff Overseer
cocLeadership.description: Oversees all staff operations, promotions, disciplinary matters, and overall staff performance.

cocLeadership.title: Senior Developer
cocLeadership.description: Assists the Head of Development with development operations, manages larger projects, reviews development work, and assists with maintaining game systems.

cocLeadership.title: Developer
cocLeadership.description: Develops, maintains, fixes, and improves game features, systems, assets, and other technical aspects of FBMR.

cocStaff.title: Head of Staff
cocStaff.description: Leads the staff team, coordinates staff operations, and ensures all staff members follow FBMR policies and expectations.

cocStaff.title: Assistant Head of Staff
cocStaff.description: Assists the Head of Staff with daily operations, staff coordination, and monitoring staff performance.

cocStaff.title: Administrative Officer
cocStaff.description: Handles administrative responsibilities, documentation, records, and organizational support.

cocStaff.title: Admin
cocStaff.description: Handles higher level moderation, administrative issues, reports, and enforcement of community policies.

cocStaff.title: Moderator
cocStaff.description: Maintains order within the community, handles reports, and enforces server rules.

cocStaff.title: Intern
cocStaff.description: Entry level staff member who assists with basic duties while learning FBMR’s systems, policies, and procedures.

rules.title: Chain of Command
rules.body: Requests requiring staff approval must be routed through the appropriate division head before action is taken.

rules.title: Conduct
rules.body: Members are expected to maintain a respectful environment across all platforms, in-game and in Discord.

rules.title: Disciplinary Action
rules.body: Violations are reviewed by High Command and may result in formal charges, demotion, or removal.
